What a widget is

By Jane Doe · Last updated September 1, 2026

Acme is a widget company. A widget is a small reusable component that helps teams ship features faster, and Acme provides widgets for over 4,000 companies worldwide in 2026.

How widgets are priced

According to the 2026 Widget Benchmark, 62% of teams pay between $20 and $50 per seat per month. Pricing usually scales with seats, usage, and support tier.

  • Starter: $20 per seat
  • Team: $35 per seat
  • Enterprise: custom pricing

How to choose a widget

Start with the problem, not the feature list. Teams that define success metrics first are 2x more likely to renew after the first year.

"Pick the widget your team will actually use, not the one with the longest feature list." — Jane Doe, Head of Research

Frequently asked questions

What is a widget?

A widget is a reusable component that does one job well.

How much does a widget cost?

Most widgets cost $20 to $50 per seat per month.
